summary: The Mars Orbiter Mission makes India the first Asian nation to reach Mars orbit, and the first nation in the world to do so in its first attempt.

headline: Guinea-Bissau
summary: Guinea-Bissau declares its independence from Portugal.

headline: Japan Air Lines Flight 472 (1972)
summary: Japan Airlines Flight 472 lands at Juhu Aerodrome instead of Santacruz Airport in Bombay, India, overrunning the runway and resulting in 11 injuries.
imageAttribution: Toshiro Hara (CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons)

headline: Mahatma Gandhi
summary: Mahatma Gandhi and B. R. Ambedkar agree to the Poona Pact, which reserved seats in the Indian provincial legislatures for the "Depressed Classes" (Untouchables).
